entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Thursday that Pierce (ankle) is "doing great" with his rehab but doesn't have a concrete timetable to resume practicing, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley suggested Friday that Bell (knee) might have a chance to play this preseason, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is on the Packers' active/non-football injury list during training camp due to a hamstring injury, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: The Texans activated Noel (finger) from the active/non-football injury list Friday morning.

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst said Wednesday that Musgrave was placed on the active/PUP list due to a neck injury and that the team is working to diagnose whether the tight end is facing a long-term issue, Tom Silverstein of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Tyler Conklin
entries.summary: The Lions activated Conklin (knee) off the active/PUP list Wednesday, Dave Birkett of the Detroit Free Press reports.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: The Bills placed Shavers (knee) on the active/PUP list Tuesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: The Seahawks have placed Charbonnet (knee) on the physically unable to perform list ahead of training camp, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
entries.summary: Rodriguez had his most active practice of training camp thus far Thursday, according to John Shipley of SI.com.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (calf) worked out on the side at Monday's practice, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: In his return to practice Thursday, Stribling (hamstring) didn't take part in team drills, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jake Bobo
entries.summary: Bobo (hamstring) did not participate in Thursday's training camp session, Gregg Bell of thenewstribune.com reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Conner (foot) isn't yet doing full-team drills at training camp, Darren Urban of azcardinals.com reports.

entries.name: John Bates
entries.summary: Bates will miss "a couple of weeks" due to a hamstring injury, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.

entries.name: Kaelon Black
entries.summary: Black is missing Monday's practice due to an adductor injury, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion said Friday that his shoulder has felt fine since returning to practice earlier this week, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

entries.name: Makai Lemon
entries.summary: Lemon (hamstring) isn't practicing Friday, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Nabers (knee) participated in team drills at Thursday's practice, Patricia Traina of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Friday that Atlanta's starters will likely see action in the team's first and third preseason games, but it remains to be seen whether Penix (knee) will be ready to take the field by then, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (quadriceps) didn't practice Wednesday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: Miles Kitselman
entries.summary: The Lions placed Kitselman (leg) on the reserve/injured list Wednesday.

entries.name: Patrick Mahomes
entries.summary: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Friday that Mahomes (knee) is unlikely to play in the Chiefs' preseason opener against the Rams on Saturday, Aug. 15, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Sione Vaki
entries.summary: Vaki suffered a broken nose in Monday's practice, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell said, "I'm taking it one day at a time" when asked Friday about his potential availability for Week 1 of the regular season versus Buffalo, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Treylon Burks
entries.summary: Burks (foot) returned to Commanders practice Saturday, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

entries.name: Tucker Kraft
entries.summary: Kraft (knee), who was activated from the active/PUP list Friday, took part in individual drills at his first practice of Packers training camp, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Xavier Worthy
entries.summary: Worthy (shoulder) didn't practice Friday, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Chris Brazzell II
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Brazzell (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: John Michael Gyllenborg
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Gyllenborg (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Ricky Pearsall
entries.summary: Pearsall (knee) is one of the few prominent athletes to have surgery on an isolated PCL injury, making it difficult to set expectations for rehab length or a potential return to pre-injury form, Eric Branch of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
